posts.text: Clarification on Individual Reflection Requirements. Your individual reflection does not need to be a 4-5 paragraph essay. 2 well-developed paragraphs are enough for full credit. Address the required components in Part III: Individual Reflection. Each group member completes their own. Submit it at the end of your group's presentation or separately as a Word document on Schoology. Extended Deadline: if you did not complete this portion only, submit by 11:59 PM tonight (October 23) without losing points.

Reminders: You are allowed to have your outline for your exam. Outline Format: On 8.5x11 sheet of paper, front and back. Handwritten or typed (12 font size). Bullet Point, NOT PARAGRAPHS. AI USAGE IS NOT ALLOWED. Ms. Browne will examine all outlines before start of exam and reserves the right to not allow outlines based on content and structure.
